name: The Commander Can't Communicate
source:
"They say you are not a person at all, only a set of armor the Goddess forgot to empty. That you eat once a year, on the solstice.

And... that you were the last to see her alive."

Ever wonder what Dark Souls would look like if it was a romance visual novel? Wonder no longer, as "The Commander Can't Communicate" lets you play as the eponymous Commander, a dread knight whose final boss energy has led them to be feared across the realm. Regular combat is a trifle to you, but talking? That's a whole other story. Certain... circumstances have led you to inherit the rulership of a small city. 

Help the Commander navigate the intricacies of local politics, a growing threat gathering outside the city gates, and maybe, just maybe find a love match along the way.  

[From [url=https://futotori.itch.io/the-commander-cant-communicate]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“人们说你根本就不是活人，只是女神忘了倒空的一副空铠甲；说你一年只在至日那天进食一次。

还有……说你是最后一个见到她活着的人。”

你可曾想过，假如《黑暗之魂》变成一部恋爱视觉小说会是什么模样？不必再凭空想象了——在《古见指挥官有交流障碍症》（《The Commander Can't Communicate》）中，你将扮演标题里的那位指挥官：一名浑身散发着最终Boss压迫感、令整个国度闻风丧胆的恐怖骑士。寻常厮杀对你而言不过是小菜一碟，可开口与人交谈？那就完全是另一码事了。偏偏由于某些……特殊变故，你阴差阳错继承了一座小城的统治权。

帮助这位社恐指挥官周旋于错综复杂的地方政治、应对城门外日益聚集的危机威胁——说不定，真的说不定，还能在途中顺便觅得一段良缘。

[摘自[url=https://futotori.itch.io/the-commander-cant-communicate]itch.io[/url]]
